label: LightONKaroo
description: Manual ANT+ and Bluetooth bike light control for Hammerhead Karoo 3 with Software Threat Mode, G-Brake Light, Speed-Adaptive Lighting, and iGPSPORT smart light support.
releaseNotes:
* iGPSPORT Custom Slots Fix: Dedicated per-slot Save buttons (4dp rounded corners) writing directly to all 3 LED channels (High, Low, Main) for VS1800S, VS1200S, VS800S, VS500
* Experimental G-Brake Light: Karoo accelerometer G-sensor brake light (0.10g to 0.50g) with 200ms continuous Y-axis deceleration filter and 0s..5s hold time. Priority: Hard OFF > Radar Threat > G-Brake Light
* Experimental Speed-Adaptive Lighting: Auto-switching from Primary ON to Secondary ON above target GPS speed (10 km/h to 40 km/h). Priority: Hard OFF > Radar Threat > G-Brake Light > Speed-Adaptive
* Automatic Version Auto-Cleanup: Detects new APK version installation and automatically clears stale JSON data on first boot
* Reset All Settings Button: Factory reset button with confirmation dialog
